procedure_metadata.name: AchiveExtraction
procedure_metadata.purpose: Configurable ordered actions on designated Drive ZIP archives using existing MetaProcedure JS Runner and Apps Script eval bridge.

definitions.archive: Drive file addressed by exact file id and alias
definitions.action: Registered Apps Script archive operation selected in config.json
definitions.run_id: Unique identifier of this execution's evidence

available_actions.description: Get Drive metadata without decompressing ZIP
Decompress ZIP and list entry names and sizes; subject to Apps Script blob/execution limits
Decompress ZIP and write exact named entries as separate Drive files
Copy the original archive to the configured destination without changing source

operations.task: Validate archive IDs, aliases and ordered action registry
Run this procedure JSON script using existing MetaProcedure JS Runner in a GitHub Node.js workflow
POST apps-script-source.js as sourcecode with config as arguments
Apps Script processes the action sequence and writes run-scoped report to Google Drive
Read the matching report independently through Google Drive and compare every configured action to report status and output artifacts
On recoverable failure modify configuration or use a verified repair branch then re-execute and re-evaluate

constraints: Exact archive IDs and ordered actions are supplied by user in config.json.
No arbitrary size threshold; Apps Script limitations may prevent decompressing large ZIPs.
Never infer extraction success from HTTP status.
Never execute arbitrary user supplied action type; only registered operations.
Avoid overwrite of existing artifacts; report names include run_id.
invariants: Source Drive IDs retain size and last-modified timestamp within the observable procedure.
No final PASS without independent Drive readback and action evidence.

transition_model.REMOTE_EXECUTED: DRIVE_RECORDED when new report is observed

required_checks: Run id equals requested run id
All configured actions present in order
Every output locator resolves to a Drive file

error_model.unzip_failure: Record action error in Drive report; obey on_error policy
error_model.missing_selected_entry: Record missing entry and fail the action
error_model.remote_timeout: Before retry check Drive for run-specific result to avoid duplicate effects

return_contract.complete_if: All mandatory Drive checks pass and current execution action evidence exists

procedure_execution_semantics.dispatch: one initial POST launches entire configured Apps Script sequence
procedure_execution_semantics.gemini: Not required for routine execution; configurable PromptGemini used only when explicitly requested for review or adaptive repair
